recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage 1960s-style album cover featuring a warm, sepia-toned close-up portrait of a female vocalist with blonde, textured hair, wearing a sequined garment. The composition is dominated by a soft-focus, high-contrast photographic style with bold, blocky typography positioned at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm monochromatic palette unifying subject and background
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial features and hair texture
Top-aligned, heavy-weight typography contrasting with soft photographic edges
Tight cropping focusing on the head and shoulders
coreInvariants: Sepia or warm amber color cast
Bold, uppercase display type at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright, textured blonde hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold white text at the top, down to the subject's face, settling on the textured sequins at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and soft-focus background elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and sepia tones (mid-tones and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy white (highlights in hair and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard bold grotesque or geometric forms

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the background, above the subject's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast; heavy white display type paired with dark, extended subtitle type.

preserve: Heavy weight of the top line
Color contrast between the two lines of text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, mid-century grotesque feel of the primary text.
Captures the vintage extended look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm sepia-toned, grainy 1960s-style portrait of a woman with voluminous blonde hair and a sequined top, high contrast, soft-focus background with amber light leaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, wide, white uppercase sans-serif text at the top margin. Below it, add a second line of text in a dark brown, extended bold sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the top text bold, white, and sans-serif?
Does the image have a visible analog film grain?
Is the portrait tightly cropped on the head and shoulders?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Verify the presence of heavy grain and print artifacts
Confirm the subject's hair has high-contrast texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, warm-toned vintage portrait with top-heavy, bold sans-serif typography to evoke a 1960s soul/jazz record aesthetic.
